messages:
sarah: Heads up — Voltix (acct_acct_54321) says they were charged twice on their annual renewal. Looks like auto-renew + a manual AP payment both went through. Can billing take a look? :eyes:

luis: Can you paste the invoice/charge IDs and any webhook logs you have?

sarah: Sure — invoices: `INV-2026-4321` (auto-renew) and `INV-2026-4322` (manual). Charge IDs: `ch_1A2B3C` and `ch_1A2B3D`. Amount: $14,000.00 + VAT 20% each. Customer sent a PO `PO-7890` that their AP says was meant to apply to the renewal, but our system created a separate invoice.

emily: @sarah thanks. Do we have the payment timestamps and the raw webhook payload when the PO came in? Need that to repro matching.

sarah: Payment timestamps: auto charge `2026-03-12T15:02:11Z`, manual payment `2026-03-12T16:31:02Z`. Webhook log (sanitized):
```
{
  "customer_id": "acct_acct_54321",
  "invoice_id": "INV-2026-4322",
  "po_number": " PO-7890 ",
  "amount": 16800.00,
  "currency": "USD",
  "payment_method": "bank_transfer"
}
```
The `po_number` shows leading/trailing spaces. Our matching rule does strict equality on `po_number` -> `invoice.po_number`. Looks like the AP used a slightly different formatting which caused a new invoice/payment.

luis: ah ok. That explains it. We should trim/normalize PO numbers before matching. Filing a quick patch. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/PR/1247 (small change in matching util). Deploy ETA ~2h.

emily: For this customer we should refund the second charge and issue a credit note. Which charge do we want reversed? Manual or auto?

julian: Finance prefers refunding the manual payment `ch_1A2B3D` and voiding `INV-2026-4322` then issuing credit note `CN-67890`. We need customer confirmation for bank reversals. Also note VAT reclaim — both invoices had VAT applied; we'll need to adjust reporting.

sarah: Customer (Voltix) confirmed they'd like the manual payment reversed — they said their AP processed the wire because they didn't see our auto-renew notification. They asked for same-day reversal. Please proceed.

emily: Starting refund flow now. Refund ticket created: FT-55122. Initiating card/bank reversal depending on payment method.

billing-bot: Refund initiated: REF-999123 (linked to FT-55122). ETA settlement reversal 3-5 business days for bank transfer. :information_source:

luis: Quick reconciliation note for engineering: we should normalize PO string (trim + uppercase) and also strip common prefixes like "INV-" when matching historical POs. I'll include unit tests.

emily: Finance heading (cc @julian @finance) — I'll attach reconciliation sheet and the requested credit note CN-67890. Will confirm VAT handling in the credit note.

julian: Sounds good. Once refund confirms, finance will mark CN-67890 and update ledgers. Please log the customer's consent in the ticket.

sarah: Logged consent in FT-55122 and emailed Voltix legal contact. Also created follow-up infra ticket to run a one-off script to merge duplicates for any other accounts affected: TASK-9421.

emily: Verified amounts: refund `ch_1A2B3D` $16,800.00 (incl VAT). Will update FT-55122 with timeline.

sarah: Thanks everyone. Can we also add a short postmortem and put the PO-normalization change in the next minor release? This caused extra operational churn. :thumbsup:

luis: Will do — adding to 2026-03. Follow-up PR will include migration for historical whitespace variants.

emily: Done — marking this thread resolved for support, tracking in FT-55122 / TASK-9421.

sarah: Appreciated. Closing on my side once FT-55122 shows refund completed.
